name: zc_night_glow

tests.name: the Dog was found in frame and read at every setting for every skin

detail.note: a missing rect means the figure did not project into the frame; all-None readings mean the editor window was behind another one

tests.name: the night glow control actually reaches every skin

detail.note: a skin that does not move is not going through ApplyColourway and the correction misses it

tests.name: at the shipped setting every skin is still plainly brighter than the ground it stands on

detail.note: the founder asked for the flames and Celestial Light to be kept, not removed; a mascot that no longer out-reads the ground after dark has been turned off rather than corrected

tests.name: at the shipped setting no skin is mostly clipped to white

detail.note: a figure with a fifth of itself at 1.0 has lost its detail there, which is what the 04:00 capture showed: a white starburst with two eyes in it

tests.name: the correction is an improvement on doing nothing

detail.note: a skin that was never blown out at 1.00 is excused; one that was must be better at 0.32 or the correction is not doing the job it was written for
